title: Build the PID 1 chain for the payload kernel with the project's own freestanding arm64 toolchain: add userland/libmini to the pinned review files, build stage0 (as /sbin/launchd), init, etc/rc (rc.launchd) and the mkjobs.py job set, and make the small root.apfs (md1) with mkapfs.py. Replaces the donor's xnu-clang/Theos build only where this host lacks it; the sources stay the donor's.
acceptance: The donor sources used (stage0.c, init.c, libmini, rc.launchd, mkjobs.py) are pinned review files; each deviation from the donor build (compiler, linker, flags) is listed with the reason.

stage0 and init are static arm64 Mach-O executables whose load commands, entry point and imports are listed by an independent reader and contain no dynamic dependency; root.apfs is produced by mkapfs.py and read back by apfs-tool.
The evidence is host-test only: nothing ran on the phone and nothing says the kernel mounts it.
